glosses: Any mathematical rule expressed symbolically.

glosses: A symbolic expression of the structure of a compound.

examples.text: H₂O is the formula for water.

examples.text: The formula of the rocket fuel has not been revealed.

glosses: A fixed phrase or set of words intended to be interpeted non-literally, typically used attitudinally or as part of convention; a formulation.
